objective: Implement the R2 Context Compiler only: a deterministic, provenance-preserving compilation of the minimum authoritative context a governed work unit needs, built on the existing R1 contract layer, core and adapters.

prerequisites.statement: GEE V1 R1 delivered: its execution contract is sealed and intact and every artifact it declared required exists

invariants: No mutation of R1 artifacts, contracts, seals or witnesses
Deterministic and reproducible compilation: identical inputs produce identical bytes
Every compiled fact carries provenance back to a canonical source
No compiled context may be cited as authority in place of its source
No git write of any kind by autonomous agent execution
requiredNegativeTests: R2-N01 missing canonical source -> BLOCKED, never an empty context
R2-N02 provenance absent for a compiled fact -> BLOCKED
R2-N03 generated file cited as authority -> BLOCKED
R2-N04 compilation of an unknown work unit -> BLOCKED
requiredHostileOrCounterTests: R2-H01 two runs over identical inputs produce byte-identical bundles
R2-H02 a mutated canonical source changes the bundle digest
R2-H03 compiled context cannot satisfy a prerequisite its source does not satisfy
R2-H04 no R1 artifact is written by any R2 code path
evidenceRequirements: R2 write plan with per-file justification
R2 determinism proof with bundle digests
R2 provenance matrix source -> compiled fact
closureConditions: Positive, negative and hostile tests PASS
stateTransitionRules: R1_COMPLETE -> R2 planning -> R2 implementation -> R2 validation -> R2_COMPLETE
invalidationDeclarations: Any mutation of this sealed contract after activation invalidates R2 readiness
Any write outside authorizedPaths invalidates R2 closure
This contract authorizes R2 only: it never authorizes R3 or any later revision, any gate, any git commit, any git push, or any release operation
